# SvgRenderOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Low-level rendering options threaded into `SvgCanvas` by the SVG render pipeline. This is the internal counterpart of the public `SvgPageExportOptions`; it carries only the knobs the canvas itself needs.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Drawing`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new SvgRenderOptions()
```

## Properties

- [`EmbedImages`](#embedimages): How raster images are represented.
- [`Legacy`](#legacy): Shared default instance that reproduces the legacy canvas behaviour.
- [`PdfBaseline`](#pdfbaseline): When `true`, text baselines are placed a full em below the top of the line box (`y + fontSize`), matching the PDF render pipeline exactly.
- [`Precision`](#precision): Decimal places used when formatting coordinates.

### `EmbedImages`

```csharp
SvgImageEmbedding EmbedImages { get; set; }
```

How raster images are represented. Defaults to `DataUri`

### `Legacy`

```csharp
static SvgRenderOptions Legacy { get; }
```

*static, read-only*

Shared default instance that reproduces the legacy canvas behaviour.

### `PdfBaseline`

```csharp
bool PdfBaseline { get; set; }
```

When `true`, text baselines are placed a full em below the top of the line box (`y + fontSize`), matching the PDF render pipeline exactly. When `false` (the default, used by the legacy chart path) the historical `y + fontSize*0.8` approximation is used.

### `Precision`

```csharp
int? Precision { get; set; }
```

Decimal places used when formatting coordinates. When `null`, coordinates are emitted verbatim, preserving the byte-for-byte output of the standalone chart export path.
